# Basel Anaya — AI Engineer

> AI engineer and founder of Maximlabs. Builds the layer autonomous agents run on: kernel-level sandboxes (Kernex), local LLM inference systems (Mercer, Cynosure), and data pipelines. 2+ years across insurance, EdTech, and fintech. Based in Amman, Jordan (UTC+3); open to contract and freelance work.
